title: On Evaluating User Simulators for Interactive Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.24892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User simulators offer a scalable way to evaluate interactive agents, but how to assess their quality remains underexplored. In particular, it is unclear whether existing user simulator evaluation frameworks reliably detect meaningful failures in simulated user behavior. This uncertainty makes it difficult to interpret simulator evaluation. To understand what a high benchmark score tells us about simulator quality, we (meta-)evaluate the metrics themselves. To instantiate this meta-evaluation, we deliberately perturb simulated replays to induce failures such as altered goals, omitted constraints, premature stopping, and acceptance of broken work, then test whether the metrics penalize these failures. Evaluation methods from three prior studies detect only 5-6 of the 10 perturbations; their combined scores even favor populations instructed to accept broken work over unmodified controls. Motivated by these gaps, we propose a new evaluation

translated_title: 论交互式智能体用户模拟器的评估
translated_abstract: 用户模拟器为评估交互式智能体提供了一种可扩展的方式，但如何评估这些模拟器本身的质量仍缺乏充分研究。特别是，现有的用户模拟器评估框架能否可靠地检测模拟用户行为中的重大故障尚不清楚，这种不确定性使得模拟器评估结果难以解读。为了理解基准测试的高分究竟能在多大程度上反映模拟器的质量，我们对评估指标本身进行了（元）评估。为具体实现这一元评估，我们故意对模拟回放过程进行扰动以诱发多种故障，例如目标被篡改、约束条件被遗漏、过早停止以及接受不合格的工作成果，然后检验各项指标能否对这些故障进行惩罚。结果显示，来自三项先前研究的评估方法仅能检测出10种扰动中的5至6种；而且这些方法的综合评分甚至更青睐那些被指示接受不合格工作成果的模拟器群体，而非未经修改的对照组。基于这些缺陷，我们提出了一种新的评估方法。
tldr: 该论文对用户模拟器的评估指标本身进行元评估，发现现有方法无法可靠检测模拟用户行为中的多数故障，并据此提出了一种新的评估方法。
en_tdlr: This paper meta-evaluates user simulator evaluation metrics by deliberately inducing simulator failures, showing that existing methods detect only 5-6 out of 10 perturbations, and proposes a new evaluation approach to address these gaps.
